remarks: 25 FOREST ST, UNIT 7K - The Classic | Downtown Stamford, CT    LISTING SUMMARY: * Price: $3,800 / Month  Layout: 2 Bedrooms | 2 Full Bathrooms ("K" Line) - 1,267 Sq. Ft.    Fully renovated, luxury Manhattan-style apartment in Downtown Stamford. This oversized apartment is turn-key and fully renovated from top to bottom, offering the space of a house with the convenience of a luxury high-rise. Be the first to enjoy two recently renovated, brand new bathrooms featuring contemporary vanities, high-end tiling, and spa-inspired fixtures. The home has been professionally painted in a modern, neutral palette to complement any decor and is equipped with a brand-new, high-efficiency in-unit washer and dryer. A sprawling living and dining area are perfect for entertaining and you will enjoy morning coffee or evening sunsets on your private balcony. All windows and exterior doors feature brand new glass. The amenities and lifestyle are unbeatable: 24/7 Concierge service, penthouse club area, glass-enclosed indoor heated pool, fitness center, a massive rooftop sundeck and an outside picknick area. Restaurants and shopping are around the corner and the Classic is a short distance to the Metro-North Train Station (30-45 mins to NYC) and I-95. Water and gas included as well as one parking space in the building!
